description: This file contains functions and DOM manipulations for rendering and updating a chess evaluation bar in a web interface, including setting bar heights, visibility, and colors based on game evaluation data.

methods.name: setEvalBarToWinner
methods.description: Sets the evaluation bar to highlight the winner based on the current board orientation.

methods.name: setEvalTextVisible
methods.description: Controls the visibility and color of evaluation text depending on the active player and board orientation.

methods.name: drawEvaluationBar
methods.description: Main function to draw and update the evaluation bar and associated texts based on evaluation data, board orientation, and moved player.
